turns.content: A symmetric (E)-oct-4-ene sample and a symmetric (Z)-oct-4-ene sample are each treated with one equivalent of mCPBA and then aqueous acid. What is the net transformation, and what stereochemical course does the epoxidation-opening sequence follow?
Apply that sequence to (E)-oct-4-ene and determine the complete set of octane-4,5-diol stereoisomers, accounting for molecular symmetry.
Do the same for (Z)-oct-4-ene and determine its complete stereoisomer set.

The two product mixtures are combined. With ideal resolution, how many peaks should appear on an achiral reverse-phase HPLC column and how many on a chiral HPLC column? Explain using enantiomer and diastereomer resolution.
Check the assignment by identifying the meso product, the enantiomeric pair, and the species that coelute on the achiral stationary phase.
Report the full stereoisomer inventory and the predicted peak count for each chromatogram.
